subject: Hosted API: proposed monthly commit increase & rate safeguards
messages:
From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@parcelzen.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Capacity request — looking to move burst into committed monthly tier

Hi Stephanie,

Hope you’re well. We closed a new retail partner and expect sustained traffic increases starting Q4. We’re currently on the Standard hosted tier and are hitting burst limits frequently.

High level ask: can we talk about moving ~30M tokens/month from burst into a committed monthly tier starting Nov 1, and what that would do to our per-token rates and soft-throttle behavior? Procurement wants predictable billing and an SLA-safe fallback.

Available this week: Tue/Thu afternoons PST. I can loop in procurement once we have a rough number.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Greene | Head of Engineering, ParcelZen
alyssa@parcelzen.com | +1 415-555-0199
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@parcelzen.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity request — looking to move burst into committed monthly tier

Thanks Alyssa — glad to hear about the partner win, congrats.

Quick proposal for a 30M token monthly uplift:
- New monthly commit: +30,000,000 tokens (move from burst into committed band)
- Proposed blended rate: $0.00075/token for committed volume (tiered: first 10M @ $0.00080, next 20M @ $0.00070)
- Soft-throttle: keep soft-throttle threshold at 1.2x committed for short spikes; we can add a 48-hour grace window for predictable events
- Burst cushion: retain a small shared burst pocket for short spikes (up to 5M tokens/mo) at current burst overage pricing

If that looks directionally right I’ll draft an amendment for legal/finance review. Looping in Karthik for pricing approval and to flag any discount cadence we should apply. Proposed next step: 30-minute sync Thu 2pm PT to align on PO/timing.

[signature]
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity request — looking to move burst into committed monthly tier

Stephanie — thanks for the quick draft. Pricing guidance:
- Approve the blended banding but swap the band breakpoints to 12M / 18M (12M @ $0.00082, next 18M @ $0.00069) to keep margin while providing volume discount.
- We can offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to 5% of the first month’s committed spend (applied as dollar credit) if ParcelZen signs the 12-month amendment.

Laura — can legal prepare a short amendment template (addendum to existing Master Services Agreement) that: 1) increases monthly commit, 2) preserves current SLAs, 3) includes the 48-hour grace spike clause, and 4) documents the burst cushion described below. Aim to turn around an initial draft by EOD 9/7.

Karthik
Head of Sales Ops (internal note: margin target maintained)
From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@parcelzen.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: ParcelZen Procurement <procurement@parcelzen.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity request — looking to move burst into committed monthly tier

Thanks Karthik & Stephanie — that pricing ladder looks reasonable. ParcelZen is willing to commit for 12 months; procurement wants the amendment and a DocuSign envelope to review legal redlines.

Two clarifications from our side:
1) Can you confirm whether KV cache persistence is included for committed requests (we rely heavily on prefix caching for checkout flows).
2) We’ll need an invoice cadence aligned to monthly billing with a PO number on each invoice.

If you can send the amendment and a link to DocuSign, I’ll route to procurement today.

Best,
Alyssa

--
ParcelZen Procurement 
procurement@parcelzen.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@parcelzen.com>, ParcelZen Procurement <procurement@parcelzen.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity request — looking to move burst into committed monthly tier

Hi Alyssa — great, thanks. Answers and next steps below.

1) KV cache persistence: included for committed traffic under the same operational controls as your current plan. We’ll note cache persistence in the amendment.
2) Invoice cadence / PO: we’ll add monthly invoicing language and PO field in billing section of the amendment.

Attached: ParcelZen_Amendment_v1.pdf (draft amendment reflecting the 12M/18M banding, 48-hour grace window, 5% onboarding credit, and cache persistence clause).
Related link: https://docusign.example.com/Envelope/ABC123 (DocuSign envelope will be populated after legal accepts redlines).

Laura — flagged for legal redline. Can you review and return redlines by EOD 9/07 so we can send to procurement?

Alyssa / procurement — once redlines are in we’ll upload to DocuSign and share the envelope. Proposed effective date: 2026-11-01.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: ParcelZen_Amendment_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
